articles.title: Karnataka seeks review of E20 rollout, flags excess ethanol in petrol samples
articles.description: Karnataka has urged the Centre to review the E20 ethanol-blending programme after state inspections and independent lab tests allegedly found ethanol content exceeding the prescribed 20% level in several petrol samples. The state has sought mandatory disclosure of ethanol content, wider fuel choices, independent testing and compensation for consumers whose vehicles are damaged by excessive blending.

articles.title: Dalal Street crash: How Nifty, Sensex slipped from nine-month highs
articles.description: Indian stock indices experienced a downturn on Wednesday as investors engaged in profit booking following a robust market rally in November, with major benchmarks like the Nifty and Sensex recording notable losses. The consumer durables sector emerged as the worst-hit area due to sliding precious metal prices and cautious trading behavior. Despite the overall market correction, sustained foreign institutional investments and lower crude oil prices offered underlying support to Dalal Street.
